summary: A steel-framed BMX / MTB tabletop jump, 6.4 m long and 1.6 m wide: a 0.9 m kicker on a 2 m radius transition… options frame; sockets socket_kicker_toe, socket_kicker_lip, socket_table_centre, socket_landing_toe.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.bmx_ramp or place "prefab": "bmx_ramp" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
